title: Configurable Layer backgrounds
description: Allow Layer swimlane backgrounds to use the theme palette, one solid color, alternating colors, or no fill.
completion_criteria: Layer backgrounds support default, solid, alternate, and none modes.
Alternating mode can render color/no-color lanes using transparent.
Existing Layer documents retain the built-in palette.
Unsafe CSS paint values are not emitted into generated SVG.
Syntax documentation and focused tests cover the public contract.
Targeted tests, typecheck, and production build pass.
success_criteria: Authors can style business-flow swimlanes without manual coordinates.
Background styling does not alter lane membership, geometry, borders, or labels.
The same setting works for horizontal and vertical Layer orientation.
triage_notes: Gradients and arbitrary CSS variables remain out of scope because ArchMap source is untrusted text.
